catalogue.title: UI Component Catalogue
catalogue.description: Comprehensive reference and verification matrix for OrderHub B2B Admin Console base primitives. Demonstrates all six typed CVA components, variants, sizing scales, interactive states, and accessible keyboard behaviors defined in

buttons.sectionDesc: Accessible action triggers with four semantic variants, three standard control heights, pending loading states with animated spinners, and disabled states.
buttons.variantsDesc: Primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive actions.
buttons.statesDesc: Pointer events blocked, opacity-50 applied, aria-busy exposed.
buttons.sandboxDesc: Client island exercising dynamic loading toggle and click handling.

inputs.sectionDesc: Form text inputs with control-border contrast (≥ 3.0:1), persistent accessible labels, aria-invalid error resolution, and typed sizing scale.
inputs.sizesDesc: Standard control heights across density levels.
inputs.errVariantMsg: SKU must follow the pattern VATEK-XXXX-YYYY.
inputs.errAriaMsg: Please provide a complete email domain.

selects.sectionDesc: Accessible native dropdown select preserving operating system keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Space/Enter to activate, Escape to close) with typed CVA styling.
selects.sizesDesc: sm, md, and lg heights matching input scale.
selects.errorMsg: Please designate an operational warehouse for fulfillment.
selects.disabledDesc: Native select disabled with muted styling.
selects.sandboxHeading: Interactive Input & Select Live Form Sandbox

badges.sectionDesc: Compact status chips communicating state via paired semantic color contrast (≥ 6.3:1 WCAG AA) and textual labels. Never relies on color alone.
badges.variantsDesc: Neutral, success, warning, and destructive status treatments.
badges.sizesDesc: Strict 4px grid paddings: px-2 py-1 (sm), px-3 py-1 (md), px-4 py-2 (lg).

cards.sectionDesc: Structural content containers supporting compound slots: CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter.
cards.defaultContent: Elevated white surface (`bg-surface`) bounded by subtle border (`border-border`) and standard shadow (`shadow-sm`).
cards.mutedContent: Subdued neutral slate surface (`bg-muted`) designed for side panels, informational callouts, and grouped summary blocks.
cards.outlineContent: Transparent canvas (`bg-transparent`) bounded solely by subtle border (`border-border`) without drop shadow.

modals.sectionDesc: Accessible dialog powered by Radix Dialog. Enforces compile-time accessible title and description props, traps keyboard focus within the dialog, dismisses on Escape key or backdrop click, and restores focus to the invoking trigger button upon close.
modals.sandboxDesc: Demonstrates four dialog configurations exercising variants (`default`, `destructive`, `muted`) and sizes (`sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`).
